name: UniversalStateMachineUltimate

methods.name: save_entity
methods.desc:
Save entity - SECURE (requires MBR payment)
Migration: Just add mbr_payment parameter to your existing call!

methods.name: start_process
methods.desc:
Start process - SECURE (requires MBR) - NO turn enforcement
Migration: Just add mbr_payment parameter to your existing call! Either participant can update anytime.

methods.name: start_battle
methods.desc:
Start battle - SECURE (requires MBR) - NO turn enforcement
Migration: Just add mbr_payment parameter to your existing call!

methods.name: update_process
methods.desc: Update process - Either participant can update anytime

methods.name: update_battle
methods.desc: Update battle - Either player can update anytime

methods.name: start_battle_turn_based
methods.desc:
Start battle with ON-CHAIN turn enforcement
Box structure: p1 (32) + p2 (32) + deadline (8) + last_player (32) + state Blockchain enforces alternating turns - impossible to cheat!

methods.name: update_battle_turn_based
methods.desc:
Update battle with ON-CHAIN turn enforcement
Contract enforces alternating turns: - First move: Either player - Subsequent moves: MUST be the OTHER player - Transaction FAILS if same player tries twice!

methods.name: start_process_turn_based
methods.desc:
Start process with ON-CHAIN turn enforcement
Perfect for AI agents that need guaranteed alternation

methods.name: update_process_turn_based
methods.desc: Update process with ON-CHAIN turn enforcement

methods.name: get_turn_info
methods.desc:
Get turn information for turn-based battle/process
Returns: (player1, player2, last_player, is_first_move) - If last_player is zero: first move, either can go - Otherwise: the OTHER player should move next

methods.name: get_stats
methods.desc: Get statistics: entities, processes, turn_based, paused

desc:
Universal State Machine - ULTIMATE VERSION
    
    The best of all worlds:
    ✅ Fully secure - all methods require MBR payment
    ✅ Turn-based - on-chain enforcement available
    ✅ Easy migration - same method names, just add MBR parameter
    
    REGULAR METHODS:
    - save_entity/player - Secure entity storage
    - start_battle/process - Two-party collaboration, no turn enforcement
    - update_battle/process - Either participant can update anytime
    
    TURN-BASED METHODS:
    - start_battle_turn_based - Create battle with turn enforcement
    - update_battle_turn_based - CONTRACT enforces alternating turns
    - start_process_turn_based - AI agents with guaranteed alternation
    - update_process_turn_based - CONTRACT enforces alternating actions
